        (function (d) {
            var t = "";
            try {
                t = window.localStorage.getItem("pibStyle") || "";
            } catch (e) {
                t = "";
            }
            if (t === "orange") {
                t = "yellow";
            }
            var c = t === "change" ? " pib-hc"
                : t === "green" ? " pib-theme-green"

    <script type="text/javascript">
            $(document).ready(function () {
                  function getParameterByName(name) {
                        var url = window.location.href;
                        name = name.replace(/[\[\]]/g, '\\$&');
                        var regex = new RegExp('[?&]' + name + '(=([^&#]*)|&|#|$)'),
                              results = regex.exec(url);
                        if (!results) return null;
                        if (!results[2]) return '';
                        return decodeURIComponent(results[2].replace(/\+/g, ' '));
                  }
                  let prid = parseInt(getParameterByName('PRID'), 10);

                  if (!isNaN(prid) && prid > 0) {
                        $.ajax({
                              type: "POST",
                              url: "AjaxMethod.aspx/UpdatePRHitCount",
                              async: false,
                              data: JSON.stringify({ 'PermId': prid }),
                              contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                              dataType: "json",
                              success: function (response) {
                                    console.log(response);
                              },
                              error: function (error) {
                                    console.log("Error in AJAX request", error);
                              }
                        });
                  } else {
                        console.log("Invalid parameters:", prid);
                  }
            });
    </script>

            <div class="innner-page-main-about-us-content-right-part">
                <div id="MinistryName" class="MinistryNameSubhead text-center">
                    Ministry of New and Renewable Energy 
                </div>
                <div id="lg_g"><div class='log_oo'>  <img src='https://static.pib.gov.in/WriteReadData/specificdocs/photo/2026/sep/ph_9768_20260902_10000501.png' alt='azadi ka amrit mahotsav' /> </div></div>

                <div class="text-center event-heading-background">
                    
                    <h1 id="Titleh2">
                        PM Surya Ghar Yojana Drives Energy Transition: 9.56 GW Rooftop Solar Capacity Added till March 2026
                    </h1>
                    <h3 id="Subtitleh3">
                        <span id="ltrSubtitle"></span>
                    </h3>
                </div>

                <div id="PrDateTime" class="ReleaseDateSubHeaddateTime text-center pt20">
                    Posted On:
                              25 MAR 2026 5:04PM by PIB Delhi
                </div>
                
                <div class='pt20'>
                </div>
                <input type="hidden" name="hydphotoUrl" id="hydphotoUrl" />
                

                <!-- Release content wrapper for client-side zero-reflow word count -->
                <div id="pibReleaseBody">
                    <p style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif"><span style="font-size:16px">Under the PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana (PMSG: MBY), it has been estimated that RTS installation in one crore households will produce renewable electricity of 1,000 billion units, which will result in reduction of 720 million ton of CO2eq emission during the 25 years of lifetime for rooftop solar projects.</span></span></p>

<p style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif"><span style="font-size:16px">Since the launch of the PMSG: MBY in February 2024, a total of 9,566.89 MW rooftop solar (RTS) capacity has been added across the country, as on 20.03.2026. </span></span></p>

<p style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif"><span style="font-size:16px">With the implementation of PMSG: MBY, it has been estimated that around 17 lakh jobs will be created in manufacturing, logistics, supply chain, sales and installations, O&amp;M services, financial services, etc.</span></span></p>

<p style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif"><span style="font-size:16px">The PMSG: MBY is a demand driven scheme wherein all residential consumers in the country, having grid connected electricity connection of the local DISCOM can avail the benefits of the scheme, for installation of RTS systems, by applying on the National Portal of the scheme.</span></span></p>

<p style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif"><span style="font-size:16px">The Ministry has taken the following measures to promote the rooftop solar adoption and achieve target of installation of rooftop solar for one crore households in the country, under the scheme:</span></span></p>

<p style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif"><span style="font-size:16px">Online process from application to disbursal of subsidy directly into the bank account of the residential consumer through the National Portal. </span></span></p>

<p style="margin-left:29.0pt; text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif"><span style="font-size:16px">&middot;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Availability of collateral-free loan from nationalized banks at a concessional interest rate of repo-rate plus 50 bps, i.e., 5.75% per annum for the present, with a tenure of 10 years.</span></span></p>

<p style="margin-left:29.0pt; text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif"><span style="font-size:16px">&middot;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Simplified the regulatory approval process by waiving technical feasibility requirement and introducing auto load enhancement upto 10 kW.</span></span></p>

<p style="margin-left:29.0pt; text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif"><span style="font-size:16px">&middot;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Net metering agreement has been made part of application in the National Portal.</span></span></p>

<p style="margin-left:29.0pt; text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif"><span style="font-size:16px">&middot;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Included RESCO/Utility-Led Aggregation (ULA) Models</span></span></p>

<p style="margin-left:29.0pt; text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif"><span style="font-size:16px">&middot;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Simplified process for registration of vendors to ensure sufficient and qualified vendors are available.</span></span></p>

<p style="margin-left:29.0pt; text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif"><span style="font-size:16px">&middot;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Capacity building and training programmes being conducted for creating skilled manpower.</span></span></p>

<p style="margin-left:29.0pt; text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif"><span style="font-size:16px">&middot;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Creating awareness about the scheme, through awareness and outreach program such as print advertising in leading newspapers, TV commercials campaigns, Radio campaigns across FM stations including regional channels, etc., in the country.</span></span></p>

<p style="margin-left:29.0pt; text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif"><span style="font-size:16px">&middot;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Regular monitoring of the progress of the scheme at different levels including with states/DISCOMs.</span></span></p>

<p style="margin-left:29.0pt; text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif"><span style="font-size:16px">&middot;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Conducted regional review meetings from time to time.</span></span></p>

<p style="margin-left:29.0pt; text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif"><span style="font-size:16px">&middot;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Established grievance redressal mechanism for timely resolution of grievances. A Call Centre with telephone number 15555 is operational in 12 languages.</span></span></p>

<p style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif"><span style="font-size:16px">In addition, MNRE and REC ltd., as the National Programme Implementing Agency (NPIA), for PMSG: MBY, work in close coordination with all the DISCOMs, for effective implementation of the scheme.&nbsp; </span></span></p>

<p style="text-align:center">***</p>

<p><span style="font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif"><span style="font-size:16px"><strong>Navin Sreejith</strong></span></span></p>

                </div>

                    <td style="font-weight: 200; text-align: center">
                        Ministry of New and Renewable Energy 
                        <div style="height: 30px; width: 100%;">
                        </div>
                        <div style="font-weight: 200; text-align: center; font-size: 30px;">
                            PM Surya Ghar Yojana Drives Energy Transition: 9.56 GW Rooftop Solar Capacity Added till March 2026
                        </div>
                        <div style="height: 30px; width: 100%;">
                        </div>
                        <div style="font-weight: 200; text-align: center; font-size: 30px;">
                            
                        </div>
                        <div style="height: 30px; width: 100%;">
                        </div>
                        <div style="text-align: center; font-size: 14px;">
                            Posted On:
                                          25 MAR 2026 5:04PM by PIB Delhi
                        </div>
                        <div style="height: 30px; width: 100%;">
                        </div>
                        <div style="font-weight: 200; text-align: left; font-size: 16px;">
                            <p style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif"><span style="font-size:16px">Under the PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana (PMSG: MBY), it has been estimated that RTS installation in one crore households will produce renewable electricity of 1,000 billion units, which will result in reduction of 720 million ton of CO2eq emission during the 25 years of lifetime for rooftop solar projects.</span></span></p>

<p style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif"><span style="font-size:16px">Since the launch of the PMSG: MBY in February 2024, a total of 9,566.89 MW rooftop solar (RTS) capacity has been added across the country, as on 20.03.2026. </span></span></p>

<p style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif"><span style="font-size:16px">With the implementation of PMSG: MBY, it has been estimated that around 17 lakh jobs will be created in manufacturing, logistics, supply chain, sales and installations, O&amp;M services, financial services, etc.</span></span></p>

<p style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif"><span style="font-size:16px">The PMSG: MBY is a demand driven scheme wherein all residential consumers in the country, having grid connected electricity connection of the local DISCOM can avail the benefits of the scheme, for installation of RTS systems, by applying on the National Portal of the scheme.</span></span></p>

<p style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif"><span style="font-size:16px">The Ministry has taken the following measures to promote the rooftop solar adoption and achieve target of installation of rooftop solar for one crore households in the country, under the scheme:</span></span></p>

<p style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif"><span style="font-size:16px">Online process from application to disbursal of subsidy directly into the bank account of the residential consumer through the National Portal. </span></span></p>

<p style="margin-left:29.0pt; text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif"><span style="font-size:16px">&middot;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Availability of collateral-free loan from nationalized banks at a concessional interest rate of repo-rate plus 50 bps, i.e., 5.75% per annum for the present, with a tenure of 10 years.</span></span></p>

<p style="margin-left:29.0pt; text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif"><span style="font-size:16px">&middot;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Simplified the regulatory approval process by waiving technical feasibility requirement and introducing auto load enhancement upto 10 kW.</span></span></p>

<p style="margin-left:29.0pt; text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif"><span style="font-size:16px">&middot;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Net metering agreement has been made part of application in the National Portal.</span></span></p>

<p style="margin-left:29.0pt; text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif"><span style="font-size:16px">&middot;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Included RESCO/Utility-Led Aggregation (ULA) Models</span></span></p>

<p style="margin-left:29.0pt; text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif"><span style="font-size:16px">&middot;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Simplified process for registration of vendors to ensure sufficient and qualified vendors are available.</span></span></p>

<p style="margin-left:29.0pt; text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif"><span style="font-size:16px">&middot;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Capacity building and training programmes being conducted for creating skilled manpower.</span></span></p>

<p style="margin-left:29.0pt; text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif"><span style="font-size:16px">&middot;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Creating awareness about the scheme, through awareness and outreach program such as print advertising in leading newspapers, TV commercials campaigns, Radio campaigns across FM stations including regional channels, etc., in the country.</span></span></p>

<p style="margin-left:29.0pt; text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif"><span style="font-size:16px">&middot;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Regular monitoring of the progress of the scheme at different levels including with states/DISCOMs.</span></span></p>

<p style="margin-left:29.0pt; text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif"><span style="font-size:16px">&middot;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Conducted regional review meetings from time to time.</span></span></p>

<p style="margin-left:29.0pt; text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif"><span style="font-size:16px">&middot;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Established grievance redressal mechanism for timely resolution of grievances. A Call Centre with telephone number 15555 is operational in 12 languages.</span></span></p>

<p style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif"><span style="font-size:16px">In addition, MNRE and REC ltd., as the National Programme Implementing Agency (NPIA), for PMSG: MBY, work in close coordination with all the DISCOMs, for effective implementation of the scheme.&nbsp; </span></span></p>

<p style="text-align:center">***</p>

        <input type="hidden" name="ltrDescriptionn" id="ltrDescriptionn" value="&lt;p style=&quot;text-align:justify&quot;>&lt;span style=&quot;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif&quot;>&lt;span style=&quot;font-size:16px&quot;>Under the PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana (PMSG: MBY), it has been estimated that RTS installation in one crore households will produce renewable electricity of 1,000 billion units, which will result in reduction of 720 million ton of CO2eq emission during the 25 years of lifetime for rooftop solar projects.&lt;/span>&lt;/span>&lt;/p>

&lt;p style=&quot;text-align:justify&quot;>&lt;span style=&quot;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif&quot;>&lt;span style=&quot;font-size:16px&quot;>Since the launch of the PMSG: MBY in February 2024, a total of 9,566.89 MW rooftop solar (RTS) capacity has been added across the country, as on 20.03.2026. &lt;/span>&lt;/span>&lt;/p>

&lt;p style=&quot;text-align:justify&quot;>&lt;span style=&quot;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif&quot;>&lt;span style=&quot;font-size:16px&quot;>With the implementation of PMSG: MBY, it has been estimated that around 17 lakh jobs will be created in manufacturing, logistics, supply chain, sales and installations, O&amp;amp;M services, financial services, etc.&lt;/span>&lt;/span>&lt;/p>

&lt;p style=&quot;text-align:justify&quot;>&lt;span style=&quot;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif&quot;>&lt;span style=&quot;font-size:16px&quot;>The PMSG: MBY is a demand driven scheme wherein all residential consumers in the country, having grid connected electricity connection of the local DISCOM can avail the benefits of the scheme, for installation of RTS systems, by applying on the National Portal of the scheme.&lt;/span>&lt;/span>&lt;/p>

&lt;p style=&quot;text-align:justify&quot;>&lt;span style=&quot;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif&quot;>&lt;span style=&quot;font-size:16px&quot;>The Ministry has taken the following measures to promote the rooftop solar adoption and achieve target of installation of rooftop solar for one crore households in the country, under the scheme:&lt;/span>&lt;/span>&lt;/p>

&lt;p style=&quot;text-align:justify&quot;>&lt;span style=&quot;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif&quot;>&lt;span style=&quot;font-size:16px&quot;>Online process from application to disbursal of subsidy directly into the bank account of the residential consumer through the National Portal. &lt;/span>&lt;/span>&lt;/p>

&lt;p style=&quot;margin-left:29.0pt; text-align:justify&quot;>&lt;span style=&quot;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif&quot;>&lt;span style=&quot;font-size:16px&quot;>&amp;middot;&amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp; Availability of collateral-free loan from nationalized banks at a concessional interest rate of repo-rate plus 50 bps, i.e., 5.75% per annum for the present, with a tenure of 10 years.&lt;/span>&lt;/span>&lt;/p>

&lt;p style=&quot;margin-left:29.0pt; text-align:justify&quot;>&lt;span style=&quot;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif&quot;>&lt;span style=&quot;font-size:16px&quot;>&amp;middot;&amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp; Simplified the regulatory approval process by waiving technical feasibility requirement and introducing auto load enhancement upto 10 kW.&lt;/span>&lt;/span>&lt;/p>

&lt;p style=&quot;margin-left:29.0pt; text-align:justify&quot;>&lt;span style=&quot;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif&quot;>&lt;span style=&quot;font-size:16px&quot;>&amp;middot;&amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp; Net metering agreement has been made part of application in the National Portal.&lt;/span>&lt;/span>&lt;/p>

&lt;p style=&quot;margin-left:29.0pt; text-align:justify&quot;>&lt;span style=&quot;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif&quot;>&lt;span style=&quot;font-size:16px&quot;>&amp;middot;&amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp; Included RESCO/Utility-Led Aggregation (ULA) Models&lt;/span>&lt;/span>&lt;/p>

&lt;p style=&quot;margin-left:29.0pt; text-align:justify&quot;>&lt;span style=&quot;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif&quot;>&lt;span style=&quot;font-size:16px&quot;>&amp;middot;&amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp; Simplified process for registration of vendors to ensure sufficient and qualified vendors are available.&lt;/span>&lt;/span>&lt;/p>

&lt;p style=&quot;margin-left:29.0pt; text-align:justify&quot;>&lt;span style=&quot;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif&quot;>&lt;span style=&quot;font-size:16px&quot;>&amp;middot;&amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp; Capacity building and training programmes being conducted for creating skilled manpower.&lt;/span>&lt;/span>&lt;/p>

&lt;p style=&quot;margin-left:29.0pt; text-align:justify&quot;>&lt;span style=&quot;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif&quot;>&lt;span style=&quot;font-size:16px&quot;>&amp;middot;&amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp; Creating awareness about the scheme, through awareness and outreach program such as print advertising in leading newspapers, TV commercials campaigns, Radio campaigns across FM stations including regional channels, etc., in the country.&lt;/span>&lt;/span>&lt;/p>

&lt;p style=&quot;margin-left:29.0pt; text-align:justify&quot;>&lt;span style=&quot;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif&quot;>&lt;span style=&quot;font-size:16px&quot;>&amp;middot;&amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp; Regular monitoring of the progress of the scheme at different levels including with states/DISCOMs.&lt;/span>&lt;/span>&lt;/p>

&lt;p style=&quot;margin-left:29.0pt; text-align:justify&quot;>&lt;span style=&quot;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif&quot;>&lt;span style=&quot;font-size:16px&quot;>&amp;middot;&amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp; Conducted regional review meetings from time to time.&lt;/span>&lt;/span>&lt;/p>

&lt;p style=&quot;margin-left:29.0pt; text-align:justify&quot;>&lt;span style=&quot;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif&quot;>&lt;span style=&quot;font-size:16px&quot;>&amp;middot;&amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp; Established grievance redressal mechanism for timely resolution of grievances.         <script type="text/javascript">
                  const festivalStart = new Date("2025-11-20T00:00:00").getTime();
                  const festivalEnd = new Date("2025-11-28T23:59:59").getTime();
                  const countdownElement = document.getElementById("countdown");

                  if (countdownElement) {
                        const interval = setInterval(() => {
                              const now = new Date().getTime();

                              if (now < festivalStart) {
                                    const diff = festivalStart - now;
                                    const days = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
                                    const hours = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));

                                    countdownElement.innerHTML = `${days} Day${days !== 1 ? 's' : ''} ${hours} Hour${hours !== 1 ? 's' : ''} to go`;
                              } else if (now >= festivalStart && now <= festivalEnd) {
                                    const dayNumber = Math.floor((now - festivalStart) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) + 1;
                                    countdownElement.innerHTML = `56th IFFI - Day ${dayNumber}`;
                              } else {
                                    countdownElement.innerHTML = `✨ IFFI closes but never ends…`;
                                    const elements = document.querySelectorAll('.film-roll-badge');
                                    elements.forEach(el => el.style.width = "350px");
                                    clearInterval(interval);
                              }
                        }, 1000);
                  }
        </script>
        <script type="text/javascript">
                  const miffStart = new Date("2026-06-15T00:00:00").getTime();
                  const miffEnd = new Date("2026-06-15T23:59:59").getTime();
                  const miffElement = document.getElementById("miff");

                  if (miffElement) {
                        const miffInterval = setInterval(() => {
                              const now = new Date().getTime();

                              if (now < miffStart) {
                                    const diff = miffStart - now;
                                    const days = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
                                    miffElement.innerHTML = `${days} Day${days === 1 ? '' : 's'} to MIFF ...`;
                              } else if (now >= miffStart && now <= miffEnd) {
                                    const dayNumber = Math.floor((now - miffStart) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) + 1;
                                    miffElement.innerHTML = `19th MIFF - Day ${dayNumber}`;
                              } else {
                                    miffElement.innerHTML = `✨ MIFF concludes, cinema lives on...`;
                                    document.querySelectorAll('.film-roll-badge').forEach(el => el.style.width = "350px");
                                    clearInterval(miffInterval);
                              }
                        }, 1000);
                  }
        </script>

    <!-- Minimal O(N) Time and O(1) Auxiliary Space Word Count & Read Time Calculation -->
    <script type="text/javascript">
            (function () {
                  function calculateReadingStats() {
                        var bodyEl = document.getElementById("pibReleaseBody");
                        if (!bodyEl) return;

                        // textContent extracts text without triggering expensive layout/reflow computations
                        var text = bodyEl.textContent || "";
                        var words = 0;
                        var inWord = false;

                        // O(N) single pass character code scan: achieves O(1) space with zero array allocations
                        for (var i = 0, len = text.length; i < len; i++) {
                              var code = text.charCodeAt(i);
                              // Delimits on ASCII whitespace, control characters, tabs, newlines, and non-breaking spaces (160)
                              if (code <= 32 || code === 160) {
                                    inWord = false;
                              } else if (!inWord) {
                                    inWord = true;
                                    words++;
                              }
                        }

                        // Standard 250 WPM reading speed (e.g., 612 words yields 2 min read)
                        var minutes = Math.max(1, Math.round(words / 250));

                        var elWords = document.getElementById("prWordCount");
                        var elTime = document.getElementById("prReadTime");

                        if (elWords) elWords.textContent = words + (words === 1 ? " word" : " words");
                        if (elTime) elTime.textContent = minutes + " min read";
                  }

                  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
                        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", calculateReadingStats);
                  } else {
                        calculateReadingStats();
                  }
            })();
    </script>

    <script type="text/javascript">
            (function () {
                  try {
                        if (window.self === window.top) { return; }
                  } catch (e) { return; }
                  var s = document.createElement("style");
                  s.textContent = ".sticky-social, .sticky-social_mb { display: none !important; }";
                  (document.head || document.documentElement).appendChild(s);
            }());
    </script>
</body>
</html>
